title: Chapter 201 - Hidden Purpose (2)
originalText:
Leaders then hesitated. They too had saw Jegal Sohi and Moyong Yu acting strangely, so they already thought this was someone else’s trap.

‘I know but…’

But the fight had already started so they couldn’t ease down, as they were worried that someone in other side might attack if they let down their guard. Poong Chungwun, then asked.

“Crown Prince. What do you propose that we do?”

“We will follow your order, Crown Prince.”

Sama Yi then spoke as he watched leaders of Yulin clan suspiciously. Yeowun then pointed at the hall where people were fighting and spoke.

“I want elders and guests from Yulin clan to stop those who are not under an illusion to refrain from fighting.”

“And those who are under illusion?”

“I will take care of them.”

And Yeowun immediately jumped out at the hall to the people. Poong Chungwun hesitated for a moment but jumped down and other leaders from Yulin clan then followed. Elders from Demonic Cult then moved down also when Lord Chun Yujong waved to allow their action. The Lord’s eye narrowed.

‘Who dare attack my Cult’s palace?’

His frustration was serious.

“Stop! Stop the fight now!”

“This is enemy’s trap! Our alliance will fall if we fight here!”

Leaders from both sides jumped down and shouted, and those who were not hypnotized began to stop slowly. Yeowun was moving quickly between them.

‘Nano, I can’t find all of them. Let me know who’s being hypnotized.’

[Yes, master. Activating augmented reality on the sight.]

Yeowun then saw white lines drawing over his eye and heard Nano’s voice.

[Targeting hypnotized entities.]

Yeowun saw small red circles being drawn over multiple people.

‘Nano, shock the target immediately when I lay my hands over them.’

[Yes, master.]

Nano then bolted out against targets. With the Step of Wind God skill, he moved like lightning through crowds and snatched through target’s head.

“W-what?!”

“Wake up.”

Yeowun’s hand that grabbed the head sparked in electricity.

“Aaaaargh!”

Warrior from Flower Mountain clan screamed and dropped. Yeowun then moved over to the next target.

“Huh? Aaaartgh!’

“Aaaaah!”

He then grabbed two who were fighting and shocked them. They fell down to the ground and Yeowun moved.

‘Next!’

Chun Yeowun quickly ran through each target and put them to sleep.

‘I-it’s amazing!’

Jegal Sohi was still dizzy from just being awake, so she was watching over at the stage and was astounded. She was also experienced warrior, but she couldn’t follow Yeowun’s movement with her naked eyes.

‘So, he’s the Crown Prince of the Cult…’

Yeowun was taking care of those who were hypnotized by alone. Those who Yeowun placed his hands passed out for slight moment and woke up, dumbfoundedly.

‘D-dammit! What is that?!’

The guard, who were creating more chaos through crowds became shocked. The plan was failing very quickly already. Hypnosis was hard to put in effect, but once it did, then it was hard for it to come off unless the caster stopped it by himself.

‘This is impossible! He’s breaking hypnosis in every touch!’

With leaders from both group taking care of the situation, it seemed the situation was going to solve very quickly.

‘Ugh, there’s no way.’

He realized his plan had failed and the Hypnotizer, had only one choice to make.

‘There is no way to run from here.’

He decided to kill himself. There were best warriors from Demonic Cult in this hall, and it was middle of the Cult’s castle, where thousands of cultists lived. There was no way to run away from middle of the castle itself. And he was going to kill himself once his plan succeeds, and had planted poison ball on his molar teeth.

“Hmmmmmph.”

He let out a long breath and was about to bit on the poison ball, when someone grabbed his neck.

“Ugh!”

It was Chun Yeowun. Yeowun already had taken care of every hypnotized warriors and found the Hypnotizer right away.

‘How did he find me?!’

Hypnotizer’s eye grew large. He figured he would become suspicious as other guard was already captured, but this was too fast.

‘Ugh, this fool, I will teach him a lesson!’

He was angry that Yeowun had made all of his three plans to fail. He then threw his fist against Yeowun’s chest.

“HUH?!”

But his fist couldn’t even come close to Yeowun’s chest as it was grabbed by Yeowun. He tried to pull it away, but it didn’t even budge as the energy difference was too great.

‘H-how can he have so much power at that age?!’

Yeowun then looked up coldly at the man who was hanging by his hand, and twisted the fist that he grabbed.

“You think you can mess around in the middle of the Cult and be fine?”

“Aaaaaargh!”

But this wasn’t over.

“W-wait, what are you… AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!”

Yeowun then pulled the twisted hand of the Hypnotizer and with the sound of muscle and flesh being ripped, his entire arm was pulled off from his body. The pain was beyond the level one can bare.

“UGH!”

“H-he pulled the arm!”

Warriors from forces of justice became pale at the cruel sight. They thought such sight was surely fitting the name of Demonic Cult. Yeowun then asked coldly to the hypnotizer who was in pain as he grabbed on the shoulder with his remaining left hand.

“What are you?”

“W…wah…. Yo-you think… you can…”

There was no way to get away anyway. The Hypnotizer then tried to bit on the poison ball, but before he can chew it down, his mouth was forced open from powerful energy.

“Aaaaaaaa!”

“Your type always try to kill yourself if something doesn’t turn out right.”

Yeowun flicked his finger, and the molar teeth that had poison ball wrapped around was pulled out.

“Urgh!”

Hypnotizer’s eye turned into fear as he saw the teeth with poison ball floating in the air in front of his eyes. He didn’t even dream that such monster existed within the Cult. And Yeowun’s last word had made him shocked.

“I have to take care of ‘master’ of yours, so I’ll see you later.”

L'arme et la technique mortelle de Lee Hameng qui brûle les blessures de ses victimes.
Le terme désignant les forces orthodoxes ou le monde martial dans certaines factions.
Un phénomène inexpliqué généré par la fusion d'une énergie plasmatique anormale, créant une illusion puissante et matérielle.

glossary.translation: Épée à Droite, Paume à Gauche
glossary.notes: Le summum des arts martiaux du Clan de la Sagesse, consistant à utiliser simultanément une technique d'épée et une technique de paume.
L'ancien Seigneur du Culte Démoniaque et grand-père de Chun Yeowun, porté disparu depuis une vingtaine d'années.
Le 7e Ancien du Culte Démoniaque.
Stade de cultivation avancé, juste avant le niveau suprême.
Le dernier chef ou dirigeant restant du Clan du Poison après la perte de leurs forces majeures.
Forme d'origine mythique et sacrée de la créature avant que sa corne ne soit tranchée et qu'elle ne se corrompe en serpent-dragon noir.
Forteresse contrôlée par le Clan Yulin dans la province de l'Anhui.
Forteresse stratégique sous le contrôle du Culte Démoniaque.
Un puissant clan orthodoxe appartenant aux Forces de la Justice.
L'une des techniques d'épée les plus avancées du Culte Démoniaque.
Autre appellation du Docteur Baek, renommé pour ses talents médicaux hors pair au sein du culte.

glossary.original: Lady Mu from the Wise Clan
glossary.translation: Dame Mu du Clan de la Sagesse
glossary.notes: Membre éminente du Clan de la Sagesse et instigatrice présumée d'un complot d'empoisonnement.
Cadet issu du Clan de la Lame, impliqué dans l'embuscade mortelle contre Yeowun.
Seigneur du Culte Démoniaque d'il y a 500 ans.
Autre appellation du Sword Demon.
Organe dirigeant du Culte Démoniaque composé des anciens.
Titre donné au dirigeant par intérim du Culte.
Le fondateur mythique du Culte Démoniaque.
4e Ancien du Culte Démoniaque et chef du Clan Loyal.
L'une des épées puissantes forgées pour Yeowun.
Une variante du qi de force infusée par l'énergie plasmatique sombre de l'Épée du Démon Céleste, émanant une aura sinistre.
Un des instructeurs de l'Académie Démoniaque présent à la sortie de la cinquième épreuve.
Le dépôt secret du Clan du Poison contenant toutes leurs substances toxiques.
Un quartier ou un secteur où se répandent des rumeurs au sein du culte.

glossary.translation: Technique de déplacement du Dieu du Vent
glossary.notes: L'art martial de mouvement emblématique du Grand Gardien Marakim.
Secte orthodoxe prestigieuse appartenant au Clan Yulin (Forces de la Justice).
Le chef du Clan du Mont Hua, l'un des dix-sept dirigeants des Forces de la Justice.
L'une des grandes familles martiales orthodoxes du Clan Yulin.
Chef de la Famille Moyong, l'un des dix-sept dirigeants des Forces de la Justice.
Art martial propre au Clan des Illusions Fantômes, basé sur des formations complexes et des mouvements imprévisibles.
Mère de Baek Churku et épouse de Baek Munsu.
Fils aîné de Baek Oh, père de Baek Churku et successeur légitime à la tête du Clan du Poison.
L'un des dirigeants influents du Clan du Poison.
Le plus jeune instructeur de l'Académie Démoniaque, présent lors de la cinquième épreuve.
Grade militaire et martial officiel accordé par le Culte à ceux ayant atteint le niveau de maître.
L'épreuve ultime de l'Académie Démoniaque consistant à défier et vaincre l'un des doyens du Culte.
Chef du Clan du Poing Démoniaque et père de Ko Wanghur.
Chef du Clan de la Porte de l'Ouest.
Chef du Clan de la Hache de Force.

glossary.translation: Clan de la Hache de Force
glossary.notes: L'un des clans du Culte Démoniaque.
Le duo d'armes légendaires qui symbolisera Chun Yeowun dans le futur.
Surnom redoutable attribué à Baek Oh, chef du Clan du Poison.
La Seconde Stratège du Clan Yulin, réputée pour son intelligence et sa beauté exceptionnelle, faisant d'elle l'une des Trois Beautés du Jianghu.
Le fils aîné du chef du Clan Yulin, considéré comme l'avenir de la faction, et l'amant de Jegal Sohi.
Fils de Moyong Kang et fier héritier de la prestigieuse Famille Moyong.
Institution d'élite dédiée à la formation des jeunes guerriers prometteurs des Forces de la Justice.
Titre honorifique désignant les trois femmes les plus magnifiques de tout le monde martial.
Un rang tactique majeur au sein des Forces de la Justice, occupé par Jegal Sohi.
Surnom redouté de Baek Oh, chef du Clan du Poison, réputé pour sa létalité.
Forteresse ou point de ralliement utilisé par les dirigeants de l'Alliance Yulin.
Art martial terrifiant du Clan du Poison.
Technique permettant de condenser le qi pour le tirer comme un projectile.
Légende médicale dont l'identité ou la localisation est rare.
Un guerrier de niveau grand maître chargé de garder le cinquième étage de la bibliothèque.
Le stade ultime du niveau supérieur où les cinq énergies internes fusionnent en une seule.
Un état spirituel atteint au niveau suprême, permettant de puiser dans l'esprit du corps humain.
Un processus mystique de mue et de régénération physique qui survient lors d'une illumination martiale majeure.
Moine éminent du Monastère Sorim et l'un des cinq meilleurs guerriers du Wulin.
Le guerrier le plus puissant de la Force du Mal, membre des cinq meilleurs guerriers du Wulin.
L'un des cinq meilleurs guerriers du Wulin, appartenant au Clan Martial.
L'un des grands clans orthodoxes du Wulin.
Le poste de commandant en second du Culte Démoniaque, autrefois occupé par le Démon de l'Épée.
La première femme Seigneur du Culte Démoniaque, fille de l'ancien Seigneur et fondatrice d'un nouveau système clanique.
Plante utilisée dans la création de drogues puissantes et d'anesthésiants capables de rendre une personne vulnérable à l'hypnose.
Fonctionnalité d'analyse de Nano permettant de capter et déchiffrer les ondes des communications télépathiques environnantes.
Cadet fidèle ayant rejoint le groupe de Chun Yeowun avant l'escalade avec les autres clans.
